finding.article: The December 2025 Habr news item quotes State Duma deputy Andrey Svintsov explicitly advocating the gradual 'soft expulsion' of Google services from Russia and saying services may progressively slow or become harder to use so citizens and business have time to move to Russian alternatives.
finding.commentary_pattern: In the same discussion, some users shift causal responsibility toward Google or both sides, including the frame that Google itself blocks Russian users and that the 'iron curtain is being built from both sides'.
finding.relevance: This is a public example of a blame-shifting narrative coexisting with explicit official discussion of deliberate service degradation/restriction. It is relevant to TECHNICAL-BLAME-SHIFTING-PREPOSITIONING but does not prove coordinated account management.

user_observation.claim: The user reports seeing similar technical talking points and accounts whose registration dates trace back to 2014, suggesting possible long-lived pre-positioned personas or narrative assets.
user_observation.note: The article author exTvr is publicly indexed as registered in 2023, so account age must be checked individually and cannot be inferred from participation in this thread.

examples_from_thread.summary: Argues that Google also blocks connections from Russia and says the iron curtain is being built from both sides.
Supports the 'both sides' framing in reply to the same discussion.
Pushes back and provides a generic anti-abuse explanation for VPN/datacenter-IP restrictions, serving as a useful negative/control interpretation.

epistemic_firewall: A Habr account created in 2014 would not by itself prove pre-positioning, state sponsorship, bot operation or coordination.
Legitimate Google anti-abuse controls against VPN/datacenter/shared-NAT traffic exist and are a necessary negative control.

The strongest pattern is not 'Google never blocks Russian users'; it is the coexistence of explicit Russian policy advocacy for deliberate service degradation with public narratives attributing resulting access problems to Google or 'both sides'.
State-linked coordination requires account/infrastructure/operator evidence beyond rhetoric similarity and account age.
next_collection: Verify registration dates and historical activity of specific accounts repeating the same technical explanation.
Check whether relevant accounts were active before 2022/2024 YouTube throttling episodes or became active only around policy events.
Cluster repeated technical phrases, links and timing across Habr, VK, Telegram, Threads and other Russian-language platforms.
Preserve genuine cases where Google itself blocked or degraded access as negative controls.
